items.summary: Security disposition: evidence_needed. Risk severity is high for fleet-wide go-live, new public exposure, and security-sensitive releases; no clean bill of health is supported. Evidence timestamp: 2026-10-01T04:50:05.408Z. Scope: 61 managed sites. Fleet-doctor is not OK and has no run, checks, findings, or site results; operations has no deploy, uptime, or error-sweep results. Authentication and access boundaries, secrets handling, container isolation, release/deploy controls, dependency and supply-chain provenance, TLS configuration, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness are unevidenced. TLS has no certificates expiring within 30 days, but that does not establish correct TLS configuration. Compliance is technical-only: 35 pass, 20 fail, 6 unknown; it is not certification. No credential exposure, exploit, or vulnerability is established. Exact decision: do not clear go-live, public-exposure expansion, or security-sensitive releases. Permit ordinary reversible growth only when it adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, data collection, or cross-site behavior and remains within existing consent, disclosure, and data-handling boundaries.

Security review of the candidate plan: retain the planning-only scaffold pipeline and the existing allthingsmasonic.com CTA refinement only after capacity and overlap clearance. These are not security clearances. Any preview, deployment, new public exposure, credential or permission change, dependency addition, data-collection change, or cross-site behavior requires renewed evidence and security review.
